title: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
headline: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
ai_overview: More video game developers are using generative AI tools in their jobs compared to last year, according to the GDC Festival of Gaming's latest annual industry survey. Forty percent of developers surveyed say they use it "as part of their job," an increase from 36 percent in 2025.
